_comment: Single source of truth for every pinned version in this workshop. scripts/setup.mjs and scripts/doctor.mjs both read this file. Change a version here and nowhere else.

prometheus.notes: Downloaded as a self-contained archive into vendor/ so we do not depend on brew/choco/apt packaging differences.

java.notes: Java is required only because the Selenium Grid hub and nodes are Java processes. Selenium dropped Java 8 in 2023; 11 is the floor, 17 LTS is what we test against.

node.notes: Node 20 is the floor because the scripts use fetch, node:test-free ESM and stable fs/promises APIs. 22 LTS recommended.

playwright.notes: Pinned in package.json. Playwright's Selenium Grid support is experimental and Chromium/Chrome-only - see docs/SETUP.md#the-playwright--grid-caveat.

grid.nodePortsNote: Deliberately NOT Selenium's default 5555: that is also ADB's default port, so anyone with an Android emulator running would collide. Change these here if you hit a conflict; every script reads this file.
grid.notes: 3 nodes x 1 session = 3 slots. Tests run with 6 workers so queuing is guaranteed by arithmetic, not by CPU contention.
